note.title: Why we open one category at a time.
note.p1: We would rather sell a few things we can stand behind than a long list we can't. So each category opens only when we can source it properly, price it clearly and deliver it well.
note.p2: Flowers came first because they leave no room for excuses: a bouquet has one day to be right. Everything after them is held to the same standard.

atelier.metaDescription: Sanguine is a house of considered things, based in Dhaka. We opened with flowers and add new categories one at a time, delivered across Bangladesh.
atelier.lede: A house of considered things, opening one category at a time.
atelier.s1p1: Sanguine is a young house based in Dhaka. We opened in 2026 with flowers, and more categories are on the way, each opening when it is ready. We deliver across Bangladesh.
atelier.s1p2: We started small on purpose. It is easier to do one thing properly than many things at once, and we would rather add a category late than add it badly.
atelier.s2p1: Some pieces are in stock and ship within two days. Others, like our bouquets, are made when you order them, and for those we confirm the price with you before anything is made.
atelier.s2Quote: Clear prices. Careful delivery. Paid for when it arrives.
atelier.s2p2: Delivery is by Pathao and Steadfast to all sixty-four districts. You can pay the courier in cash on arrival, so you see what you ordered before you pay for it.
atelier.s3p1: Fewer things, chosen carefully. Prices you can see. Policies written in plain words. If something arrives wrong, we put it right.
atelier.s3p2: We would rather tell you what a thing is than how it should make you feel, and describe exactly what you will receive.
atelier.s3Quote: We would rather do one thing well than many things quickly.
atelier.s4p1: Flowers were first. More categories will follow, each opened only when we can do it properly.
atelier.s4p2: If you'd like to hear when that happens, join the newsletter. We write rarely.
atelier.ctaText: The best introduction is the pieces themselves.
